blocks.source: Canto XXVII
blocks.translation: Canto XXVII

blocks.source: Già era dritta in sù la fiamma e queta
blocks.translation: Already was the flame erect and quiet,

blocks.source: per non dir più, e già da noi sen gia
blocks.translation: To speak no more, and now departed from us

blocks.source: con la licenza del dolce poeta,
blocks.translation: With the permission of the gentle Poet;

blocks.source: quand’ un’altra, che dietro a lei venìa,
blocks.translation: When yet another, which behind it came,

blocks.source: ne fece volger li occhi a la sua cima
blocks.translation: Caused us to turn our eyes upon its top

blocks.source: per un confuso suon che fuor n’uscia.
blocks.translation: By a confused sound that issued from it.

blocks.source: Come ’l bue cicilian che mugghiò prima
blocks.translation: As the Sicilian bull (that bellowed first

blocks.source: col pianto di colui, e ciò fu dritto,
blocks.translation: With the lament of him, and that was right,

blocks.source: che l’avea temperato con sua lima,
blocks.translation: Who with his file had modulated it)

blocks.source: mugghiava con la voce de l’afflitto,
blocks.translation: Bellowed so with the voice of the afflicted,

blocks.source: sì che, con tutto che fosse di rame,
blocks.translation: That, notwithstanding it was made of brass,

blocks.source: pur el pareva dal dolor trafitto;
blocks.translation: Still it appeared with agony transfixed;

blocks.source: così, per non aver via né forame
blocks.translation: Thus, by not having any way or issue

blocks.source: dal principio nel foco, in suo linguaggio
blocks.translation: At first from out the fire, to its own language

blocks.source: si convertïan le parole grame.
blocks.translation: Converted were the melancholy words.

blocks.source: Ma poscia ch’ebber colto lor vïaggio
blocks.translation: But afterwards, when they had gathered way

blocks.source: su per la punta, dandole quel guizzo
blocks.translation: Up through the point, giving it that vibration

blocks.source: che dato avea la lingua in lor passaggio,
blocks.translation: The tongue had given them in their passage out,

blocks.source: udimmo dire: «O tu a cu’ io drizzo
blocks.translation: We heard it said: “O thou, at whom I aim

blocks.source: la voce e che parlavi mo lombardo,
blocks.translation: My voice, and who but now wast speaking Lombard,

blocks.source: dicendo “Istra ten va, più non t’adizzo”,
blocks.translation: Saying, ‘Now go thy way, no more I urge thee,’

blocks.source: perch’ io sia giunto forse alquanto tardo,
blocks.translation: Because I come perchance a little late,

blocks.source: non t’incresca restare a parlar meco;
blocks.translation: To stay and speak with me let it not irk thee;

blocks.source: vedi che non incresce a me, e ardo!
blocks.translation: Thou seest it irks not me, and I am burning.

blocks.source: Se tu pur mo in questo mondo cieco
blocks.translation: If thou but lately into this blind world

blocks.source: caduto se’ di quella dolce terra
blocks.translation: Hast fallen down from that sweet Latian land,

blocks.source: latina ond’ io mia colpa tutta reco,
blocks.translation: Wherefrom I bring the whole of my transgression,

blocks.source: dimmi se Romagnuoli han pace o guerra;
blocks.translation: Say, if the Romagnuols have peace or war,

blocks.source: ch’io fui d’i monti là intra Orbino
blocks.translation: For I was from the mountains there between

blocks.source: e ’l giogo di che Tever si diserra».
blocks.translation: Urbino and the yoke whence Tiber bursts.”

blocks.source: Io era in giuso ancora attento e chino,
blocks.translation: I still was downward bent and listening,

blocks.source: quando il mio duca mi tentò di costa,
blocks.translation: When my Conductor touched me on the side,

blocks.source: dicendo: «Parla tu; questi è latino».
blocks.translation: Saying: “Speak thou: this one a Latian is.”

blocks.source: E io, ch’avea già pronta la risposta,
blocks.translation: And I, who had beforehand my reply

blocks.source: sanza indugio a parlare incominciai:
blocks.translation: In readiness, forthwith began to speak:

blocks.source: «O anima che se’ là giù nascosta,
blocks.translation: “O soul, that down below there art concealed,

blocks.source: Romagna tua non è, e non fu mai,
blocks.translation: Romagna thine is not and never has been

blocks.source: sanza guerra ne’ cuor de’ suoi tiranni;
blocks.translation: Without war in the bosom of its tyrants;

blocks.source: ma ’n palese nessuna or vi lasciai.
blocks.translation: But open war I none have left there now.

blocks.source: Ravenna sta come stata è molt’ anni:
blocks.translation: Ravenna stands as it long years has stood;

blocks.source: l’aguglia da Polenta la si cova,
blocks.translation: The Eagle of Polenta there is brooding,

blocks.source: sì che Cervia ricuopre co’ suoi vanni.
blocks.translation: So that she covers Cervia with her vans.

blocks.source: La terra che fé già la lunga prova
blocks.translation: The city which once made the long resistance,

blocks.source: e di Franceschi sanguinoso mucchio,
blocks.translation: And of the French a sanguinary heap,

blocks.source: sotto le branche verdi si ritrova.
blocks.translation: Beneath the Green Paws finds itself again;

blocks.source: E ’l mastin vecchio e ’l nuovo da Verrucchio,
blocks.translation: Verrucchio’s ancient Mastiff and the new,

blocks.source: che fecer di Montagna il mal governo,
blocks.translation: Who made such bad disposal of Montagna,

blocks.source: là dove soglion fan d’i denti succhio.
blocks.translation: Where they are wont make wimbles of their teeth.

blocks.source: Le città di Lamone e di Santerno
blocks.translation: The cities of Lamone and Santerno

blocks.source: conduce il lïoncel dal nido bianco,
blocks.translation: Governs the Lioncel of the white lair,

blocks.source: che muta parte da la state al verno.
blocks.translation: Who changes sides ’twixt summer-time and winter;

blocks.source: E quella cu’ il Savio bagna il fianco,
blocks.translation: And that of which the Savio bathes the flank,

blocks.source: così com’ ella sie’ tra ’l piano e ’l monte,
blocks.translation: Even as it lies between the plain and mountain,

blocks.source: tra tirannia si vive e stato franco.
blocks.translation: Lives between tyranny and a free state.

blocks.source: Ora chi se’, ti priego che ne conte;
blocks.translation: Now I entreat thee tell us who thou art;

blocks.source: non esser duro più ch’altri sia stato,
blocks.translation: Be not more stubborn than the rest have been,

blocks.source: se ’l nome tuo nel mondo tegna fronte».
blocks.translation: So may thy name hold front there in the world.”

blocks.source: Poscia che ’l foco alquanto ebbe rugghiato
blocks.translation: After the fire a little more had roared

blocks.source: al modo suo, l’aguta punta mosse
blocks.translation: In its own fashion, the sharp point it moved

blocks.source: di qua, di là, e poi diè cotal fiato:
blocks.translation: This way and that, and then gave forth such breath:

blocks.source: «S’i’ credesse che mia risposta fosse
blocks.translation: “If I believed that my reply were made

blocks.source: a persona che mai tornasse al mondo,
blocks.translation: To one who to the world would e’er return,

blocks.source: questa fiamma staria sanza più scosse;
blocks.translation: This flame without more flickering would stand still;

blocks.source: ma però che già mai di questo fondo
blocks.translation: But inasmuch as never from this depth

blocks.source: non tornò vivo alcun, s’i’ odo il vero,
blocks.translation: Did any one return, if I hear true,

blocks.source: sanza tema d’infamia ti rispondo.
blocks.translation: Without the fear of infamy I answer,

blocks.source: Io fui uom d’arme, e poi fui cordigliero,
blocks.translation: I was a man of arms, then Cordelier,

blocks.source: credendomi, sì cinto, fare ammenda;
blocks.translation: Believing thus begirt to make amends;

blocks.source: e certo il creder mio venìa intero,
blocks.translation: And truly my belief had been fulfilled

blocks.source: se non fosse il gran prete, a cui mal prenda!,
blocks.translation: But for the High Priest, whom may ill betide,

blocks.source: che mi rimise ne le prime colpe;
blocks.translation: Who put me back into my former sins;

blocks.source: e come e quare, voglio che m’intenda.
blocks.translation: And how and wherefore I will have thee hear.

blocks.source: Mentre ch’io forma fui d’ossa e di polpe
blocks.translation: While I was still the form of bone and pulp

blocks.source: che la madre mi diè, l’opere mie
blocks.translation: My mother gave to me, the deeds I did

blocks.source: non furon leonine, ma di volpe.
blocks.translation: Were not those of a lion, but a fox.

blocks.source: Li accorgimenti e le coperte vie
blocks.translation: The machinations and the covert ways

blocks.source: io seppi tutte, e sì menai lor arte,
blocks.translation: I knew them all, and practised so their craft,

blocks.source: ch’al fine de la terra il suono uscie.
blocks.translation: That to the ends of earth the sound went forth.

blocks.source: Quando mi vidi giunto in quella parte
blocks.translation: When now unto that portion of mine age

blocks.source: di mia etade ove ciascun dovrebbe
blocks.translation: I saw myself arrived, when each one ought

blocks.source: calar le vele e raccoglier le sarte,
blocks.translation: To lower the sails, and coil away the ropes,

blocks.source: ciò che pria mi piacëa, allor m’increbbe,
blocks.translation: That which before had pleased me then displeased me;

blocks.source: e pentuto e confesso mi rendei;
blocks.translation: And penitent and confessing I surrendered,

blocks.source: ahi miser lasso! e giovato sarebbe.
blocks.translation: Ah woe is me! and it would have bestead me;

blocks.source: Lo principe d’i novi Farisei,
blocks.translation: The Leader of the modern Pharisees

blocks.source: avendo guerra presso a Laterano,
blocks.translation: Having a war near unto Lateran,

blocks.source: e non con Saracin né con Giudei,
blocks.translation: And not with Saracens nor with the Jews,

blocks.source: ché ciascun suo nimico era cristiano,
blocks.translation: For each one of his enemies was Christian,

blocks.source: e nessun era stato a vincer Acri
blocks.translation: And none of them had been to conquer Acre,

blocks.source: né mercatante in terra di Soldano,
blocks.translation: Nor merchandising in the Sultan’s land,

blocks.source: né sommo officio né ordini sacri
blocks.translation: Nor the high office, nor the sacred orders,

blocks.source: guardò in sé, né in me quel capestro
blocks.translation: In him regarded, nor in me that cord

blocks.source: che solea fare i suoi cinti più macri.
blocks.translation: Which used to make those girt with it more meagre;

blocks.source: Ma come Costantin chiese Silvestro
blocks.translation: But even as Constantine sought out Sylvester

blocks.source: d’entro Siratti a guerir de la lebbre,
blocks.translation: To cure his leprosy, within Soracte,

blocks.source: così mi chiese questi per maestro
blocks.translation: So this one sought me out as an adept

blocks.source: a guerir de la sua superba febbre;
blocks.translation: To cure him of the fever of his pride.

blocks.source: domandommi consiglio, e io tacetti
blocks.translation: Counsel he asked of me, and I was silent,

blocks.source: perché le sue parole parver ebbre.
blocks.translation: Because his words appeared inebriate.

blocks.source: E’ poi ridisse: “Tuo cuor non sospetti;
blocks.translation: And then he said: ‘Be not thy heart afraid;

blocks.source: finor t’assolvo, e tu m’insegna fare
blocks.translation: I absolve thee beforehand; and thou instruct me

blocks.source: sì come Penestrino in terra getti.
blocks.translation: How to raze Palestrina to the ground.

blocks.source: Lo ciel poss’ io serrare e diserrare,
blocks.translation: Heaven have I power to lock and to unlock,

blocks.source: come tu sai; però son due le chiavi
blocks.translation: As thou dost know; therefore the keys are two,

blocks.source: che ’l mio antecessor non ebbe care”.
blocks.translation: The which my predecessor held not dear.’

blocks.source: Allor mi pinser li argomenti gravi
blocks.translation: Then urged me on his weighty arguments

blocks.source: là ’ve ’l tacer mi fu avviso ’l peggio,
blocks.translation: Until it seemed to me that silence was the worse;

blocks.source: e dissi: “Padre, da che tu mi lavi
blocks.translation: And said I: ‘Father, since thou washest me

blocks.source: di quel peccato ov’ io mo cader deggio,
blocks.translation: Of that sin into which I now must fall,

blocks.source: lunga promessa con l’attender corto
blocks.translation: The promise long with the fulfilment short

blocks.source: ti farà trïunfar ne l’alto seggio”.
blocks.translation: Will make thee triumph in thy lofty seat.’

blocks.source: Francesco venne poi, com’ io fu’ morto,
blocks.translation: Francis came afterward, when I was dead,

blocks.source: per me; ma un d’i neri cherubini
blocks.translation: For me; but one of the black Cherubim

blocks.source: li disse: “Non portar: non mi far torto.
blocks.translation: Said to him: ‘Take him not; do me no wrong;

blocks.source: Venir se ne dee giù tra ’ miei meschini
blocks.translation: He must come down among my servitors,

blocks.source: perché diede ’l consiglio frodolente,
blocks.translation: Because he gave the fraudulent advice

blocks.source: dal quale in qua stato li sono a’ crini;
blocks.translation: From which time forth I have been at his hair;

blocks.source: ch’assolver non si può chi non si pente,
blocks.translation: For who repents not cannot be absolved,

blocks.source: né pentere e volere insieme puossi
blocks.translation: Nor can one both repent and will at once,

blocks.source: per la contradizion che nol consente”.
blocks.translation: Because of the contradiction which consents not.’

blocks.source: Oh me dolente! come mi riscossi
blocks.translation: O miserable me! how I did shudder

blocks.source: quando mi prese dicendomi: “Forse
blocks.translation: When he seized on me, saying: ‘Peradventure

blocks.source: tu non pensavi ch’io löico fossi!”.
blocks.translation: Thou didst not think that I was a logician!’

blocks.source: A Minòs mi portò; e quelli attorse
blocks.translation: He bore me unto Minos, who entwined

blocks.source: otto volte la coda al dosso duro;
blocks.translation: Eight times his tail about his stubborn back,

blocks.source: e poi che per gran rabbia la si morse,
blocks.translation: And after he had bitten it in great rage,

blocks.source: disse: “Questi è d’i rei del foco furo”;
blocks.translation: Said: ‘Of the thievish fire a culprit this;’

blocks.source: per ch’io là dove vedi son perduto,
blocks.translation: Wherefore, here where thou seest, am I lost,

blocks.source: e sì vestito, andando, mi rancuro».
blocks.translation: And vested thus in going I bemoan me.”

blocks.source: Quand’ elli ebbe ’l suo dir così compiuto,
blocks.translation: When it had thus completed its recital,

blocks.source: la fiamma dolorando si partio,
blocks.translation: The flame departed uttering lamentations,

blocks.source: torcendo e dibattendo ’l corno aguto.
blocks.translation: Writhing and flapping its sharp-pointed horn.

blocks.source: Noi passamm’ oltre, e io e ’l duca mio,
blocks.translation: Onward we passed, both I and my Conductor,

blocks.source: su per lo scoglio infino in su l’altr’ arco
blocks.translation: Up o’er the crag above another arch,

blocks.source: che cuopre ’l fosso in che si paga il fio
blocks.translation: Which covers the moat where is paid the fee

blocks.source: a quei che scommettendo acquistan carco.
blocks.translation: By those who, sowing discord, win their burden.
